~~~{=latex}
\begin{algorithm}[H]
\small\setstretch{1}\DontPrintSemicolon
\caption{Pathwise exact Huber CD with an MM scale update}
\label{alg:concomitant}
\KwInput{$X\in\mathbb R^{n\times p},y\in\mathbb R^n,\lambda_1\ge\cdots\ge\lambda_L>0$;
$\rho,\sigma^{(0)},\epsilon>0,\ K\in\mathbb N_+$;
\addition{$a>0,\ B\in\mathbb N_+,\ \chi\in\{0,1\}$}}
$\widehat\beta_0\leftarrow0$; $\widehat\sigma_0\leftarrow\sigma^{(0)}$\;
\For{$\ell=1,\ldots,L$}{
 $\beta\leftarrow\widehat\beta_{\ell-1}$; $r\leftarrow y-X\beta$;
 $\sigma\leftarrow\widehat\sigma_{\ell-1}$\;
 \For{$k=1,\ldots,K$}{
  \addition{\If{$\chi=1$}{
   \If{$r=0\ \mathrm{or}\ 2na\ge\rho^2\#\{i:r_i\ne0\}$}{
    \KwReturn{$((\widehat\beta_m,\widehat\sigma_m,\kappa_m)_{m<\ell},(\beta,0,0))$}
   }
   \For{$b=1,\ldots,B$}{
    $\sigma\leftarrow\{(2an)^{-1}\sum_i\min(r_i^2,\rho^2\sigma^2)\}^{1/2}$\;
   }
  }}
  \addition{$\delta\leftarrow\rho\sigma$; $\eta\leftarrow\sigma\lambda_\ell$}\;
  \addition{$E\leftarrow\{j:\beta_j\ne0\}\cup\{j:|X_j^\top\psi_\delta(r)/n|>\eta\}$}\;
  \For{$j\in E,\quad j\uparrow$}{
   $u\leftarrow r+X_j\beta_j$; $\beta_j^-\leftarrow\beta_j$\;
   $\beta_j\leftarrow\mathrm{ExactHuberCoordinate}(u,X_j,\delta,\eta)$\;
   $r\leftarrow r-X_j(\beta_j-\beta_j^-)$\;
  }
  $v_\beta\leftarrow R_\beta(\beta,r,\sigma,\lambda_\ell)$;
  \addition{$v_\sigma\leftarrow\chi R_\sigma(r,\sigma)$}\;
  \If{$\max(v_\beta,\addition{v_\sigma})\le\epsilon$}{\textbf{break}}
 }
 $\widehat\beta_\ell\leftarrow\beta$;
 \addition{$\widehat\sigma_\ell\leftarrow\sigma$};
 $\kappa_\ell\leftarrow\mathbf1_{\{\max(v_\beta,\addition{v_\sigma})\le\epsilon\}}$\;
 \If{$\kappa_\ell=0$}{\KwReturn{$(\widehat\beta_m,\widehat\sigma_m,\kappa_m)_{m=1}^{\ell}$}}
}
\KwReturn{$(\widehat\beta_\ell,\addition{\widehat\sigma_\ell},\kappa_\ell)_{\ell=1}^{L}$}
\end{algorithm}

\begin{algorithm}[H]
\small\setstretch{1}\DontPrintSemicolon
\caption{$\mathrm{ExactHuberCoordinate}(u,x,\delta,\eta)$}
\label{alg:coordinate}
\KwInput{$u,x\in\mathbb R^n,\ \delta>0,\ \eta\ge0$}
\KwOutput{$\displaystyle\theta\in\arg\min_{b\in\mathbb R}
          \{n^{-1}\sum_i h_\delta(u_i-x_ib)+\eta|b|\}$}
$g_0\leftarrow-n^{-1}\sum_i x_i\mathrm{sign}(u_i)\min\{|u_i|,\delta\}$\;
\If{$|g_0|\le\eta$}{\KwReturn{$0$}}
$d\leftarrow-\mathrm{sign}(g_0)$;\quad $D\leftarrow dg_0+\eta$;\quad $c\leftarrow0$\;
$I\leftarrow\{i:x_i\ne0\}$\;
\For{$i\in I$}{
 $w_i\leftarrow x_i^2/n$;\quad
 $a_i\leftarrow u_i/(dx_i)-\delta/|x_i|$;\quad
 $b_i\leftarrow u_i/(dx_i)+\delta/|x_i|$\;
}
$S\leftarrow\sum_{i\in I}w_i\mathbf1_{\{a_i\le0<b_i\}}$\;
$\{v_1<\cdots<v_M\}\leftarrow
  (\{a_i:i\in I\}\cup\{b_i:i\in I\})\cap(0,\infty)$\;
\For{$m=1,\ldots,M$}{
 $J_m\leftarrow\sum_{i\in I}w_i(\mathbf1_{\{a_i=v_m\}}-\mathbf1_{\{b_i=v_m\}})$\;
 \If{$S>0\ \mathrm{and}\ D+S(v_m-c)\ge0$}{\KwReturn{$d(c-D/S)$}}
 $D\leftarrow D+S(v_m-c)$;\quad $c\leftarrow v_m$;\quad $S\leftarrow S+J_m$\;
}
\KwReturn{$dc$}
\end{algorithm}
